Messages.Author: Andrew Daley
Messages.Body:
Just seeking clarification on card text.
Redeem the Lost Soul [AH:R2, CE:R]
Cardtype: Master

Master.
Choose a vampire in your ash heap. Gain X pool, where X is half of the
blood capacity of that vampire (round down). Remove that vampire from
the game.

Does this mean the card in the ash heap or the vampire? Does this mean
that the particular vampire that was redeemed can no longer be in play
or brought into play?

Andrew.

The card in the ash heap is the vampire.

> that the particular vampire that was redeemed can no longer be in play
> or brought into play?

Yes. The card that is removed from the game can never be put into play.
Other copies of that card are unaffected, however.

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:



You remove the *vampire card* in the Ash Heap from the game. That card can
no longer be in play or brought into play. If however you have another copy
of the same vampire in your crypt (or elsewhere) then it can be brought into
play.
